subject: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move pricing to your finance team: 

1) Target pilot scope: ~3M tokens/month (inference only) for 3 months, with occasional higher burst days (~10M tokens).
2) Quality bar: same prompt sets we walked through; you'll run a short eval with your data.
3) Pricing target: you mentioned your finance lead is looking for a ballpark ~$550–650 / 1M tokens (net) — I captured that as your target range.

Could you confirm a) that range is still what finance expects, and b) who on your side owns procurement/finance so I can send the pricing worksheet and a short SOW? If you prefer, we can loop them into a 15-min call tomorrow.

Attached: pricing-model-v2.xlsx (live template) and a draft pilot SOW for scoping.

Next steps I’ll take after you confirm owner: fill the worksheet with the 3M baseline, add an uplift model for bursts, and include our recommended autoscale/burst delta.

Thanks —
Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: pricing-model-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 68KB)
Attachment: pilot-sow-draft.docx (document, 24KB)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlasai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot

Neha — thanks for the summary and the worksheet. Confirming: the $550–650 / 1M tokens is what I initially communicated, but finance will likely target the low end if we get committed throughput guarantees.

Finance owner is Sofia Martinez (cc’d). She handles procurement for pilots < $50k and will route to our central procurement for anything above that. Sofia — can you confirm whether a 3-month pilot with expected spend in the ~ $9k–$12k range (before discounts) needs a PO or just an MSA + SOW?

Also, we have an internal metric team that will run the eval next week and share a short report. If you can provide estimated monthly spend by SKU (model variant + quantization) in the worksheet, that will help.

—Daniel
CTO, Atlas AI
daniel.park@atlasai.com
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@atlasai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlasai.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot

Hi Neha —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick answers: 
- For a 3-month pilot with estimated spend < $15k, we usually sign an SOW against our standard MSA; procurement does not need a separate PO.
- Our finance team will want the unit economics broken down (baseline tokens, burst model, per-1M token price, any reserved capacity discounts). Please include a clear line for tax/VAT if applicable.

I’ll be the signatory for the pilot SOW, but anything above $50k will route to central procurement.

If possible, can you send a version of the worksheet with the 3M baseline + burst model and a 'total expected spend' row? I’ll forward it internally once I have that.

—Sofia Martinez
Head of Finance, Atlas AI
sofia.m@atlasai.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@atlasai.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot

Hi Sofia — appreciate the clarity. Looping Rishi (pricing lead) and Marissa (CS lead) to confirm the numbers and finalize the worksheet for you.

Rishi / Marissa — action items:
- Fill the pricing-model-v2.xlsx with: 3M baseline tokens/month, burst up to 10M on peak days (assume 3 peaks/month), and a 3-month pilot term.
- Provide two pricing rows: list price and committed baseline discount (if any).
- Add an explicit per-1M-token net price line (this is what Sofia asked for).

Target: I’ll send the completed worksheet back to Sofia by EOD today so she can circulate.

Thanks —
Neha
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@atlasai.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlasai.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot

Thanks — filled and attached the worksheet with the numbers and a short notes tab explaining assumptions. Highlights:
- Baseline: 3,000,000 tokens / month
- Burst model: up to 10M tokens on 3 peak days / month (we model an 8% uplift on monthly consumption)
- List price (inference standard): $900 / 1M tokens
- Committed pilot price: $595 / 1M tokens (applies to baseline, net after standard pilot 10% discount)
- Burst overage charge: $850 / 1M tokens (charged only if monthly tokens > baseline by > 25%)
- Estimated monthly spend (baseline only): $1,785 (3M / 1M * $595) — total pilot spend over 3 months: $5,355

Notes: We kept your target band in mind and positioned the committed pilot at $595 / 1M which sits comfortably in the $550–650 window Daniel mentioned. If Atlas needs firm throughput or lower unit economics, we can propose a reserved capacity add-on (monthly commit) to push to the low-$500s.

Attached: pricing-model-v2.xlsx (updated, 102KB)

Rishi
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@atlasai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlasai.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token economics & finance owner confirmation — Atlas AI pilot

Neha / Rishi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the worksheet. I’ll circulate internally; this looks within expectations.

One ask before we sign: can you add a single-line summary in the SOW with the expected pilot total ($5,355) and the signatory (Sofia Martinez, Head of Finance)? I’ll need that to push through our internal signoff chain.

If everything checks, I can sign the SOW next week and we can start the pilot the week of Apr 20.

—Sofia
